reviews.text:
It's been a year now since Winston, our 2-year-old lemon beagle, started going for walks with Nicolas once a week, and they clicked instantly! As soon as I say the name "Nicolas," nothing else exists around Winston: he dashes straight to the street where he knows Nicolas is waiting for him. 😊

Nicolas is very attentive to Winston, but also to the group composition, ensuring each dog finds their place and fully enjoys the walks.

He's also very accommodating, and I trust him completely. He has a key to our house, which allows us to be at work with complete peace of mind when he picks up Winston and brings him back after his walk.

Winston loves his walks with him, and we're thrilled to have found someone so reliable and attentive to our dogs.

I highly recommend his services! 😊

A huge thank you to Nicolas for everything he brings to Ulysse's daily life! Living in Paris isn't always ideal for our four-legged friends, but thanks to Nicolas and his fantastic walks in the forest, our furry friends get a real breath of fresh air and a true dog's life! It's pure bliss for our Parisian four-legged friends 🌲🐾

Nicolas is a true enthusiast who takes the time to create balanced groups of dogs to encourage calm interactions and wonderful playtime in nature. Thanks to these outings, Ulysse has made so much progress with other dogs! Okay, he's still as energetic as ever and still rushes at people for scratches... but with his adorable face, no one can resist him (and especially not us!).

When I see how overjoyed Ulysse is every Thursday morning and how he dashes into the van to get back to the forest and his buddies, I know he's in great hands.

I 100% recommend Nicolas to anyone wanting to give their furry friend a truly blissful break in the forest. See you Thursday! 🐶✨

Nicolas has been taking care of my dog ​​Skady every week for the past nine months, and I trust him completely. He has a key to my apartment and manages everything independently.
Skady adores him, and I can see from the videos he sends me how much fun she has during the walks. Nicolas is very attentive to her needs and personality, and communication via WhatsApp is always seamless. The walks do come at a price, but the quality of service is truly exceptional. I wholeheartedly recommend Nicolas's dog walks!

Thank you to Nicolas for taking such good care of Vivi while I work… me behind my desk and her frolicking in the woods. I love the little videos of her walks; they make me feel like I'm right there with her. And then there's always his smile, a kind word, and the regular get-togethers with the other dog owners over a drink! It's really lovely!
Amazing service!

Nicolas is simply the best dog sitter in the world. Passionate, patient, and intelligent, he's been taking care of my dogs for 15 years, and it goes without saying that I wouldn't change him for the world! I highly recommend him!
The shop is great! Well curated selection of things not available in the other pet shops in the neighborhood.
Nico is awesome!!!

A really nice shop.
Jane is lovely with animals and gave us great advice.
They have lots of good quality treats and food.
Great offer and super welcome, I recommend it! 🩵✨ …
Always a great experience in this shop! Excellent value for money.
Very good, lots of choice and quality items
A lovely shop that offers great products for animals. My dog ​​loves the chicken treats.
Great products, great service, happy dogs ❤️
An excellent store with a good selection, always good advice, a pleasure to come here every time!
A fantastic shop with high-quality items and treats! A very warm welcome, thank you so much!
A great place for our little dog. Welcoming and full of good things.
Wonderful shop, great experience, excellent advice from amazing people with a beautiful dog!!
Excellent service. I recommend it! 🙌🏻🙌🏻 …
My golden retriever loves the horns that you can only find here!
The best pet shop around!
Great place, great advice, treats and lots of balls!
I come here often and it's always great!
Absolutely fantastic! The natural treats they offer make my little Loulou incredibly happy. Original and high-quality products!

Dogwalker, founded by Nicolas, offers the best walks for our dogs! Nicolas is passionate about dogs, has extensive knowledge of their behavior, and will always do his best to accommodate your schedule. Available and attentive, I highly recommend his services!
It's always a pleasure to go there to get the best treats for my dog.
An amazing store with quality items we don't usually see elsewhere. I love everything and would have left with it all!!! The service was also fantastic. A real favorite for our furry friends!
Nicolas has a wonderful way with animals, and the walks in the forest with the La Laisse group are always a real pleasure. In the end, a relaxed Shiba Inu – thank you so much!

Nicolas took care of our dog after we returned from the Caribbean, helping her adjust. Thanks to his walks, outings with other dogs, and his training, our dog progressed quickly. We trust him completely and highly recommend entrusting your pets to him without hesitation!

A must-visit shop in the Batignolles district. Tiny loves going there and the welcome is incredibly warm. The products are high quality. It's like taking a child to a candy store 😋 Thank you, Nicolas! …

A very pleasant place where dogs and owners alike feel comfortable with quality products.
A must-try!

For years now, our dog Pixie has been lucky enough to go for walks in the forest with Nicolas... I highly recommend him! He's super professional, reliable, and experienced. Pixie looks forward to seeing him every day.

Superb experience.
My dog ​​is living her best life with La Laisse and Nicolas.

If you're looking for dog walks in the forest with pick-up from your home, I highly recommend La Laisse. Don't just hire anyone! Nicolas is extremely responsible, careful, friendly, and super punctual. Our Pomsky adores him. He jumps for joy when we say his name and comes back from his walks super happy. 👍👍 …

On our first day in Paris, we discovered La Laisse! Since then, our dog Bruno has been in love with Nicolas and his shop, and of course, with his dog Lupa! Nicolas is always very professional, always has a smile on his face, and knows how to be with our dog who suffers from anxiety. I highly recommend La Laisse for all the excellent products offered in the shop and certainly for the weekly walks in the woods.
Great shop where we can find everything for the happiness of dogs.

So, my dog ​​knows as soon as we start heading downstairs that he's going to see his best buddy Nicolas and have a perfect walk! Nicolas is always full of smiles, kindness, and is very attentive to our little fluffball, and very accommodating when we have a problem or a change in circumstances.

And the shop is welcoming, with a great selection of good and beautiful things for our pets. You can feel that there's a lot of love and wonderful intentions from Nicolas.
I highly recommend it!

Nicolas has been walking our dog since he was 6 months old (4 years now), and my dog ​​is still just as happy to see him every Thursday! It's clear that Nicolas loves dogs and, above all, knows them very well and knows how to handle them! Plus, the shop is great, and we're always greeted with a smile!
Top-notch products and service: after a walk in the dog park, a mandatory stop on a leash, you won't be disappointed ;)
An excellent professional in whom I have great confidence and whom I highly recommend.
Scott is always delighted with his rides with Nicolas; this service is very convenient and Nicolas is very attentive to our needs, don't hesitate!!
My dog's favorite store!!
Great store, very welcoming
Best boutique in Batignoles for our pooches, always a pleasure!

The service is always perfect, and the selection is much appreciated by the dogs and us parents 😉
I highly recommend this shop; I haven't left it since I discovered it. …
Very nice shop, very pleasant service!
Went in looking for a leash, the girl at the store was very kind and took her time in explaining the available options. Great service
Nice shop and lovely staff, but prices a bit too high (long live Paris!).
Great shop, a must-visit in the neighborhood! Quality products at low prices and excellent advice!
The service and products are top-notch.

Excellent service. Nicolas is a true professional, a dog lover, and very reliable, which our young dog has always appreciated.

Highly recommended.
Catherine W
Highly professional. My dog ​​enjoys lovely walks in the forest. I highly recommend them. Expertise like this is a rare find in this field.

Always a big smile to welcome us.
A huge selection, all of high quality, reflecting the owner's passion.

Thank you, Nicolas, for everything.

Avril and Anthony
Great shop, you can find everything you need for your dog. And the owner, Nicolas, also offers dog walks in Boulogne. Our dog, Charly, can't get enough of it :) Thank you, Nicolas, for everything!
